Channel.title: TV Channel
Channel.description: Permanently stored TV channel in the shared broadcast monitoring catalog synced across all laptops and mobile devices.

channelId.description: Optional channel ID matching office autosave XML files.

channelName.description: Display name of the TV channel.

visibility.description: Visibility scope of the channel catalog entry.

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the channel.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the channel was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the channel was last updated.

AdminUser.title: Admin Registry Entry
AdminUser.description: Authoritative registry of administrators who can manage any channel in the shared broadcast catalog.

grantedByUid.description: UID of the bootstrap administrator who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/channels/{channelKey}.description: Shared permanent catalog of TV channels synchronized across all devices.

/admins/{uid}.description: Trusted administrator lookup registry (no PII stored).
